how_to_apply: Download the official notification and fill in the bio-data form printed on pages 5 and 6.

Fill in your personal details, your qualifications from Matriculation/Madhyamik onwards, your memberships of professional bodies, every post you have held, the training you have done in India and abroad, any honours, and how soon you can join.
Paste one recent passport-size photograph on the form, then sign the declaration with the date and place.
Attach self-attested copies of your mark-sheets, certificates and other testimonials as proof of age, education, experience and state of domicile. Do not send originals.
Write "Application for the post of General Manager (Technical) in TPGL" on the envelope.
Post it to: The Managing Director, Tripura Power Generation Limited, Corporate Office, Bidyut Bhavan (Old Building), North Banamalipur, Pin – 799001, so that it arrives by the last date.

Applications that arrive late or are incomplete will not be considered. Papers sent after the closing date will also be ignored. The Corporation is not responsible for postal delays and will not answer questions about postal delay, the interview or shortlisting. Canvassing in any form disqualifies you. If you applied under the earlier Advertisement No. TPGL/2026-27/01 dated 10.08.2026, you do not need to apply again. Your application will be considered along with the new ones. You may send an updated bio-data before the new last date. The terms of the present advertisement replace those of the earlier one.

content_sections.heading: About TPGL
content_sections.text: Tripura Power Generation Limited is a Government of Tripura enterprise that runs power generating stations and generation projects in the state. Its Corporate Office is at Bidyut Bhavan (Old Building), North Banamalipur, Agartala, and this is where applications for this post go.

content_sections.heading: TPGL General Manager (Technical) Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notice states that the number of posts may increase or decrease, and that the Corporation may choose not to fill the vacancy if the circumstances call for it. For in-service candidates on deputation and direct recruits below 60 years of age, pay is fixed at level 20 of the pay matrix under the "Tripura State Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2018". This corresponds to Pay Band Scale Rs. 37400-67000 (HAG + Scale). The minimum basic pay is Rs. 118500, and these allowances are paid on top of it: Retired candidates and those above 60 years get Rs. 1,00,000 (Rupees one lakh only) a month on a consolidated basis. This amount is not linked to any pension from earlier service. All pay is subject to revision by the Government or the Corporation. Other facilities: Leave under the Tripura State Government's Leave Rules Medical bill reimbursement under Tripura State Government Rules TA bills for official tours under Tripura State Government Rules A vehicle and a mobile phone as per Company Policy FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: TPGL General Manager (Technical) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age is 65 (sixty five) years, counted on the last date for receipt of applications. The notice states that this limit may be relaxed for a deserving candidate. You need a consistently good academic record with at least 55% marks in B.E. / B.Tech. in Electrical / Mechanical Engineering from a University or Institution recognised by UGC / AICTE. Where a grading system is used, an equivalent grade on a point scale is accepted. You need at least 20 (twenty) years of working experience at managerial level in any Public or Private Sector Power Utility. This must include adequate exposure to installing and commissioning new power projects, and to the operation and maintenance of Generation Systems, including Commercial and System Operation, Tariff and Material Management. For a deserving candidate, the 20-year requirement may be reduced. These job specifications are the minimum. Meeting them does not guarantee a call for interview. The selection committee may relax any of the terms for selection and appointment. For the exact eligibility wording, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: The General Manager (Technical) works as a Line Manager and reports to the Director (Technical). The managerial duties are: Setting tasks and targets in line with the Corporation's goals and assigning work to Line Managers Running technical and organisational functions with proper systems and controls Building a positive work culture and motivating staff Carrying out programmes of the Central Government and the Government of Tripura Running random checks of offices and project work, collecting feedback and taking corrective action The technical duties are: Keeping power generation uninterrupted and reliable through proper operation and maintenance of generating stations, including all types of transformers, with protection at every level Coordinating Generation, Transmission and Distribution, with proper relay coordination Material management, inventory, disposal of scrap material, and asset creation through TPGL projects Preparing DPRs, finishing tendering on time, and monitoring construction quality under generation projects and schemes Reducing transformer failure rates and working towards zero accidents through safety awareness Any other assignment given by the Director (Technical) or the Managing Director

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on an interview only, and only shortlisted candidates are called. If shortlisting is needed, it may be done through a written test, academic records, higher educational qualifications and experience. The decision of the Screening Committee and the Appointing Authority on shortlisting is binding. The Corporation does not pay T.A. / D.A. for attending the interview. Original documents must be shown at the interview, or at any other time the Corporation decides.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on contract for 3 (three) years. The appointing authority may extend it if both sides agree. No pension is paid by the Government of Tripura or TPGL. EPF benefits are available if you want them and if they apply. Either side can end the contract with 30 days' notice or by paying 1 (one) month's salary. Other service conditions are the same as for Tripura State Civil Service Officers of the equivalent grade. A Government of Tripura officer appointed on deputation stays under the service conditions of their original employment. In-service candidates may apply directly. If selected, they must bring a 'Release Order' or 'Deputation Order' from their present employer when joining. Without it, they cannot join.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TPGL General Manager (Technical) Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the official notification and fill in the bio-data form printed on pages 5 and 6. Fill in your personal details, your qualifications from Matriculation/Madhyamik onwards, your memberships of professional bodies, every post you have held, the training you have done in India and abroad, any honours, and how soon you can join. Paste one recent passport-size photograph on the form, then sign the declaration with the date and place. Attach self-attested copies of your mark-sheets, certificates and other testimonials as proof of age, education, experience and state of domicile. Do not send originals. Write "Application for the post of General Manager (Technical) in TPGL" on the envelope. Post it to: The Managing Director, Tripura Power Generation Limited, Corporate Office, Bidyut Bhavan (Old Building), North Banamalipur, Pin – 799001, so that it arrives by the last date. Applications that arrive late or are incomplete will not be considered. Papers sent after the closing date will also be ignored. faq.question: Q1. Which engineering branches are eligible for the TPGL General Manager (Technical) post?
faq.answer: Electrical and Mechanical Engineering only. You need a B.E. / B.Tech. with at least 55% marks from a UGC / AICTE recognised University or Institution.

faq.question: Q2. Can retired officers apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Retired candidates, and anyone above 60, can apply up to the age limit of 65 years. They are paid Rs. 1,00,000 a month on a consolidated basis, with no link to any pension they receive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum basic pay for a candidate below 60?
faq.answer: Rs. 118500 at level 20 of the pay matrix. DA (now 44%), Compensatory Allowance of Rs. 400 and HRA of Rs. 10000 a month are paid on top, along with a 12% employer's EPF contribution.

faq.question: Q4. Is the job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a 3-year contract that may be extended by mutual consent, and either side can end it with 30 days' notice. No pension is paid.

faq.question: Q5. What should I write on the envelope?
faq.answer: Write "Application for the post of General Manager (Technical) in TPGL" and send it to the Managing Director at Bidyut Bhavan (Old Building), North Banamalipur, Pin – 799001.

faq.question: Q6. I applied under Advertisement No. TPGL/2026-27/01. Do I need to apply again?
faq.answer: No. Applications under the advertisement dated 10.08.2026 will be considered automatically. You may send an updated bio-data by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How will the shortlist be made?
faq.answer: If shortlisting is needed, it may be done through a written test, academic records, higher qualifications and experience. The shortlisted candidates then sit an interview, which is the only basis for selection.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should go with the bio-data?
faq.answer: Self-attested copies of your mark-sheets and certificates from Matriculation/Madhyamik onwards, and proof of age, experience and state of domicile. Bring the originals to the interview.

faq.question: Q9. I work for another organisation. What do I need when joining?
faq.answer: A 'Release Order' or 'Deputation Order' from your present employer. TPGL will not let you join without it.

faq.question: Q10. Who will the General Manager (Technical) report to?
faq.answer: The Director (Technical) of the Corporation. The post works as a Line Manager and oversees the operation and maintenance of TPGL's generating stations and its projects.
